items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of 'Muddy Walter' by the INTERVIEWEE. The name appears only in the INTERVIEWER's turns. The INTERVIEWEE does not respond to or acknowledge the mention of Muddy Walter.

ctx.x: Yeah, we all enjoy that. Thank you. Okay, well, let's get back to Dewey now. Who all did you play with?

Well, I played with Charlie Pills. He played violin. Red Robey. Red Robey played guitar. And a little boy we used to have here, I mean, stuff. He played guitar. All those fellas. And shaky-head Walter. He played harmonica. Little Walter. Played with Muddy Walter now. We teached him around here. He played with harmonica.
